info.title: Alpha Vantage API
info.description: Machine-readable reference schema for the Alpha Vantage stock/market-data API, derived from the official documentation. Unlike Finnhub (path-based), Alpha Vantage is function-dispatched: nearly every request goes to a single endpoint and selects the operation via the `function` query parameter. Operations here are keyed by that function value.

notes.authentication: All requests require an `apikey` query parameter, e.g. `apikey=<yourkey>`. The docs use `apikey=demo`, which only works for a small set of hard-coded example inputs (mostly symbol=IBM). Never read the real key from .env directly; grep source for process.env references to find its variable name.
notes.requestModel: Base URL is https://www.alphavantage.co/query. Select the operation with `function=<NAME>`. The Advanced Analytics endpoints are the exception: they live on host https://alphavantageapi.co under paths /timeseries/analytics and /timeseries/running_analytics.
notes.rateLimit: Free tier is typically 25 requests/day and 5 requests/minute (subject to change). Exceeding limits returns a JSON body with a 'Note' or 'Information' field rather than an HTTP error status. Premium plans (75-1200 req/min) unlock realtime data and endpoints flagged premium=true.
notes.responseFormats: Most endpoints accept `datatype=json` (default) or `datatype=csv`. LISTING_STATUS, EARNINGS_CALENDAR, and IPO_CALENDAR return CSV only. Numeric fields in JSON responses are frequently returned as strings.
notes.errorHandling: Errors return HTTP 200 with an explanatory field: `Error Message` (bad parameters), `Note` (rate limit / throttle), or `Information` (invalid/demo key usage). Always check for these keys before parsing data.
notes.adjustedData: All technical indicators are computed from split/dividend-adjusted series to avoid artificial jumps.

api_key.name: apikey
api_key.description: Alpha Vantage API key. Claim a free key at https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key

datatype.name: datatype
datatype.description: Response format. `json` returns JSON; `csv` returns a comma-separated file.

symbol.name: symbol
symbol.description: Equity ticker symbol, e.g. `IBM`, `AAPL`, or a suffixed international symbol like `TSCO.LON`, `SHOP.TRT`, `RELIANCE.BSE`.

outputsize.name: outputsize
outputsize.description: `compact` returns the latest 100 data points; `full` returns the full-length series. For TIME_SERIES_DAILY, `full` requires a premium key.

interval_intraday.name: interval
interval_intraday.description: Intraday time interval between two consecutive data points.

entitlement.name: entitlement
entitlement.description: Controls data freshness during the US trading day. Unset = historical (end-of-day). `realtime` and `delayed` (15-min) require an eligible premium plan.

month.name: month
month.description: Query a specific historical month, e.g. `2009-01`. Any month since 2000-01 is supported. Applies to intraday time series and technical indicators.

technicalIndicatorSharedParameters.description: Parameter groups reused across the Technical Indicators category. Each indicator's `parameterGroups` field lists which of these apply, plus any indicator-specific `parameters`.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: Interval between two consecutive data points. Note: `symbol` may be an equity (IBM) or an FX/crypto pair (USDEUR).

time_period.name: time_period
time_period.description: Number of data points used to calculate each value, e.g. 10, 60, 200.

series_type.name: series_type
series_type.description: Price type in the underlying time series.

TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY.description: Current and 20+ years of intraday OHLCV candles, covering pre/post-market hours where applicable. `outputsize=full` and the `month` history parameter make this effectively premium for deep history.

parameters.name: adjusted
parameters.description: Set false for raw as-traded values.

parameters.name: extended_hours
parameters.description: Set false for regular hours (09:30-16:00 ET) only.

TIME_SERIES_DAILY.description: Raw as-traded daily OHLCV, 20+ years. `outputsize=compact` (100 points) is free; `outputsize=full` requires premium.

TIME_SERIES_DAILY_ADJUSTED.summary: Daily OHLCV with adjusted close, splits & dividends

TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY_ADJUSTED.summary: Weekly OHLCV with adjusted close and dividends

TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY_ADJUSTED.summary: Monthly OHLCV with adjusted close and dividends

GLOBAL_QUOTE.summary: Latest price & volume for one ticker (Quote Endpoint)
GLOBAL_QUOTE.description: Latest price/volume snapshot for a single symbol. End-of-day by default; realtime/delayed require premium. For bulk, use REALTIME_BULK_QUOTES.

REALTIME_BULK_QUOTES.summary: Realtime quotes for up to 100 US symbols

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Up to 100 comma-separated symbols, e.g. MSFT,AAPL,IBM.

REALTIME_BULK_BID_ASK_PRICES.summary: Realtime top-of-book bid/ask for up to 100 US symbols

SYMBOL_SEARCH.description: Returns best-matching symbols and market info with match scores, ideal for autocomplete search boxes.

MARKET_STATUS.description: Current open vs closed status of major equity, forex, and crypto trading venues worldwide.

INDEX_DATA.description: Decades of OHLC for major indices. Common symbols: DJI (Dow Jones), SPX (S&P 500), COMP (Nasdaq Composite), NDX (Nasdaq 100), VIX, RUT (Russell 2000), plus 200+ others (see INDEX_CATALOG).

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Index symbol, e.g. DJI, SPX, COMP, NDX, VIX, RUT, DJS.

INDEX_CATALOG.summary: Full list of supported index symbols

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Specific OCC contract ID, e.g. IBM270115C00390000.

parameters.name: expiration
parameters.description: Filter to one expiration on/after today.

REALTIME_PUT_CALL_RATIO.summary: Realtime put-call ratio (whole chain & per expiration)

HISTORICAL_OPTIONS.summary: Full historical option chain for a date (15+ yrs), with greeks & IV

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any date since 2008-01-01. Defaults to previous trading session.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any date since 2008-01-01. Defaults to previous session.

NEWS_SENTIMENT.description: Live and historical news with sentiment scoring across stocks, crypto, forex, and topics.

parameters.name: tickers
parameters.description: Comma list; multiple = AND. Supports CRYPTO:BTC and FOREX:USD prefixes.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Comma list; multiple = AND. Values: blockchain, earnings, ipo, mergers_and_acquisitions, financial_markets, economy_fiscal, economy_monetary, economy_macro, energy_transportation, finance, life_sciences, manufacturing, real_estate, retail_wholesale, technology.

EARNINGS_CALL_TRANSCRIPT.summary: Earnings call transcript with turn-by-turn sentiment

TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS.summary: Top 20 gainers, losers & most-active US tickers

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Keep only transactions on/after this date.

CONGRESS_TRADES.summary: Stock trades disclosed by US congressional representatives

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Provide at least symbol OR bioguide_id.

POLITICIAN_METADATA.summary: Metadata for US congressional representatives (bioguide_id, district, tenure)

INSTITUTIONAL_HOLDINGS.summary: Institutional ownership and holdings for an equity

ANALYTICS_FIXED_WINDOW.summary: Advanced analytics over a fixed window (mean, variance, correlation, etc.)
ANALYTICS_FIXED_WINDOW.note: Different host/path than the /query base. Free keys: up to 5 symbols; premium: up to 50.

parameters.name: RANGE
parameters.description: Date range. Text values full/{N}day/week/month/year (and {N}minute/hour intraday), OR pass RANGE twice for start & end (e.g. RANGE=2023-07-01&RANGE=2023-08-31), OR YYYY-MM / YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: CALCULATIONS
parameters.description: Comma list: MIN, MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN, CUMULATIVE_RETURN, VARIANCE(annualized=True), STDDEV(annualized=True), MAX_DRAWDOWN, HISTOGRAM(bins=N), AUTOCORRELATION(lag=N), COVARIANCE(annualized=True), CORRELATION(method=PEARSON|KENDALL|SPEARMAN).

ANALYTICS_SLIDING_WINDOW.summary: Advanced analytics over sliding windows (moving variance, correlation, etc.)
ANALYTICS_SLIDING_WINDOW.note: Free keys: 1 calculation & up to 5 symbols; premium: multiple calculations & up to 50 symbols.

parameters.name: CALCULATIONS
parameters.description: Comma list: MEAN, MEDIAN, CUMULATIVE_RETURN, VARIANCE, STDDEV, COVARIANCE, CORRELATION (annualized/method options as in fixed window).

DIVIDENDS.summary: Historical and declared future dividend distributions

EARNINGS.summary: Annual & quarterly EPS history with estimates and surprises

EARNINGS_ESTIMATES.summary: Annual & quarterly EPS/revenue estimates with analyst counts & revisions

LISTING_STATUS.summary: Active or delisted US stocks & ETFs (CSV only)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Point-in-time snapshot; any date after 2010-01-01. Defaults to latest trading day.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Unset returns the full scheduled list.

IPO_CALENDAR.summary: IPOs expected in the next 3 months (CSV only)

CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE.summary: Realtime exchange rate for a currency pair (fiat or crypto)
CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE.description: Also serves crypto pairs. from/to may each be a physical currency (USD) or cryptocurrency (BTC).

DIGITAL_CURRENCY_DAILY.summary: Daily crypto history (quoted in market currency & USD)

WTI.summary: Crude oil prices - WTI (source: EIA via FRED)

BRENT.summary: Crude oil prices - Brent (source: EIA via FRED)

NATURAL_GAS.summary: Henry Hub natural gas spot prices

ALL_COMMODITIES.summary: Global price index of all commodities

HT_TRENDMODE.summary: Hilbert Transform - Trend vs Cycle Mode
